segments.text: Listen to a talk in a biology podcast.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: Have you ever heard of tardigrades?

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: These are animals about half a millimeter in size, just about large enough to be visible to the naked eye.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: Tardigrades are renowned for their ability to survive a variety of extreme conditions, an ability that is unique among animals.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: They are found in diverse environments, ranging from the deep sea to high mountain tops.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: They can also withstand temperatures from just above absolute zero to over 150 degrees Celsius.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: They even survive intense radiation and the vacuum of space.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: The secret to tardigrade survival?

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: A process called cryptobiosis.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: During cryptobiosis, tardigrades lose almost all their water content and produce unique proteins that protect their cells from damage.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: But remember, no metabolic activity, meaning no bodily process, can happen without water.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: So, all metabolism essentially shuts down.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: When favorable conditions return, tardigrades rehydrate and resume normal functions.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: Scientists are fascinated by tardigrades because understanding their survival mechanisms could have important implications.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: Take health care, for example.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: If we can figure out how tardigrades protect their cells from radiation, it might lead to breakthroughs in radiation therapy for cancer patients.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: Astronomers are intrigued by tardigrades because of their ability to endure the vacuum of space.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: In a research study in 2007, tardigrades were sent to the harsh realms of space.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: Some not only survived, but they successfully reproduced upon their return to Earth.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: If tardigrades can survive in space, it suggests life might exist in the extreme environments of other planets.
